security_audit.summary: The scanner mostly mistook Markdown formatting and model identifiers for Ruby or shell backtick execution. A remote image, mutable installation guidance, broad belt permission, and hosted processing create low-to-medium privacy and supply-chain risks. No prompt injection or malicious exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: The allowed-tools rule grants access to every belt subcommand.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict permission to the belt subcommands required for login, app discovery, and app execution.

remediation.issue: Installation commands and raw instructions are not pinned to immutable versions.
remediation.suggestion: Pin skill dependencies and installation documentation to reviewed releases or commit hashes.

remediation.issue: Prompts and image URLs may contain sensitive information sent to hosted providers.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear data-handling warning and advise users to avoid confidential images, prompts, and private URLs.

remediation.issue: The introduction embeds an externally hosted image.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle a reviewed local image asset or document that rendering the file may contact the remote host.

content.user_title: Generate and Edit Images Across Leading AI Models
content.value_statement: Choosing and invoking image models individually slows creative work. This skill provides one belt CLI workflow for generation, editing, upscaling, and image stitching.
actual_capabilities: Lists hosted image models with app identifiers and recommended uses.
Provides text-to-image commands for GPT-Image, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Reve, and Seedream.
Shows image editing with a prompt and a user-provided image URL.
Supports example controls for quality and aspect ratio.
Provides an image-upscaling workflow using the Topaz app.
Shows how to stitch multiple images horizontally.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh belt CLI, authentication, network access, and hosted service availability.
Does not generate images locally or provide an offline workflow.
Does not verify current model availability, pricing, quotas, or output rights.
Does not explain provider retention policies for prompts or source images.

use_cases.title: Create Product Concepts
use_cases.description: Generate studio product images, compare model outputs, and refine backgrounds for early design reviews.

use_cases.title: Produce Campaign Visuals
use_cases.description: Create social graphics, posters with text, and wide campaign scenes from structured creative prompts.

use_cases.title: Automate Image Workflows
use_cases.description: Run repeatable generation, editing, upscaling, and stitching tasks from a command-line workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to generate an image of [subject] in [style] with [lighting]. Choose a suitable model and explain the selection.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs one image from a short brief.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Product Visual
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a professional product image for [product]. Use [background], [camera angle], and [aspect ratio]. Select a model suited to product photography.
prompt_templates.scenario: A designer needs a polished product concept.

prompt_templates.title: Edit and Upscale an Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit the image at [image URL] by changing [requested element] while preserving [protected details]. Then upscale the approved result.
prompt_templates.scenario: A user needs a controlled revision and higher resolution.

prompt_templates.title: Compare a Multi-Model Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Create [number] campaign variants for [audience] using two suitable models. Keep [brand constraints], compare results, and stitch selected images horizontally.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced team evaluates model fit across a visual campaign.

output_examples.input: Create a wide cyberpunk city image for a social campaign.
output_examples.output: Selected Grok Imagine for its aspect-ratio control. Generated a 16:9 night city scene with neon signage and a clear headline area.

output_examples.input: Change a product photo background to a sunset beach.
output_examples.output: Selected GPT-Image for image editing. Preserved the product shape and replaced the background with a warm beach scene.

output_examples.input: Improve a small approved poster and prepare a comparison strip.
output: Upscaled the approved poster with the Topaz image app.
Stitched the original and enhanced versions horizontally for review.

best_practices: State the subject, composition, style, lighting, aspect ratio, and required text before choosing a model.
Use non-sensitive image URLs and review each provider policy before submitting source material.
Generate small comparisons first, then edit and upscale only the selected result.
anti_patterns: Do not submit confidential prompts, private image links, or personal images without authorization.
Do not assume every model supports the same editing controls, dimensions, or text quality.
Do not upscale every draft before composition and content are approved.

faq.question: What do I need before using this skill?
faq.answer: Install the belt CLI, authenticate with inference.sh, and ensure network access is available.

faq.question: Can this skill edit an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. The GPT-Image example accepts an image URL and a natural-language editing prompt.

faq.question: Which models can render text in images?
faq.answer: The skill identifies Reve and Seedream 3.0 for text rendering, with a poster example for Reve.

faq.question: Can it improve image resolution?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides a Topaz image-upscaling command that accepts a source image URL.

faq.question: Does it work offline?
faq.answer: No. The workflow uses the belt CLI to call hosted inference.sh applications.

faq.question: How should sensitive images be handled?
faq.answer: Avoid confidential or personal images unless provider terms, authorization, retention, and access controls are acceptable.
